Smartphones have become an inseparable part of our daily lives—banking, online shopping, office work, and communication all happen through our mobile phones. But downloading the wrong app can put your privacy, personal data, and hard-earned money at serious risk.

A government agency has issued a warning about three mobile apps that cyber criminals are misusing to commit online fraud. These apps allow scammers to gain remote access to your phone, steal sensitive information, and empty your bank account within minutes.

Apps like AnyDesk, TeamViewer, and QuickSupport, though originally designed for technical support, are now being misused by fraudsters. Scammers often pose as bank officials, customer care agents, or government officers and trick people into installing these apps in the name of KYC updates, refunds, or account issues.
